title: fix(studio): Save waits for the CEL verdict to reach the page before it reads the hold
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ82MfFjFxvJRAyoku6XCvWt4)_

Fixes #36619

## What changes

`studioSaveBar.tsx`: the top bar's Save, after its existing wait past the lint debounce, now also awaits a render of its own at **transition** priority (`useRendersSettled`) before it reads the buffers' `held`. React commits that render only once no default-priority render is left, so the verdict's whole effect chain has reached the buffer's Save entry when Save reads it. No test file changes; the test is not skipped, retried, narrowed or slowed.

## Why — root cause (product race, not test timing)

Both red cases fail on the **first** Save, before the tab is ever left: under load, all 4 red runs failed at `DataPillar.panelHold-27629.test.tsx:233` (`expect(save).not.toHaveBeenCalled()` right after typing `record.status ==` and pressing Save). Case (b)'s `studio-held-message` miss is the same race one step later: that Save already sent the broken text, the draft is clean, so no hold is left to name.

The Save read `held` a fixed 50 ms past `LINT_DEBOUNCE_MS` (`VERDICT_SETTLE_MS`). An action predicate's verdict reaches the object's Save entry through four effect-driven renders after the lint resolves: `CelPredicateField` → `ConditionBuilder` (`onBlockingIssuesChange` effect) → `ActionDefaultInspector` (effect) → `ObjectActionsPanel` (`onCelVerdictsChange` effect) → `DataPillar` (`held`, copied into the entry ref by a layout effect). On a busy main thread the lint timer and Save's timer come due in the same timer pass, so Save's continuation runs before any of those renders and reads the pre-edit verdict (`count: 0`, judged on `true`), then sends `visible: "record.status =="`. That is the product sending a formula its check has not judged, the invariant the Save bar's header states; the rule-guard cases have a shorter chain and stayed green.

Out of scope (Acceptance notes): the fix covers verdicts already reported when Save's timer fires. A lint still in flight then (a first-load dynamic import of the CEL engine on a slow network) is not awaited; closing that needs a pending-check signal from `metadata-admin/CelPredicateField.tsx`, outside this card's file surface. Not reproduced; recorded here only.

## Verification

Loaded box: 4-core container, 4 busy-loop CPU stressors, `vitest run --maxWorkers=2` on the file alone, consecutive runs.

| | runs | red | where |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| before (`origin/main` 9e2a4acb) | 7 | 4 | all at :233, case (a) |
| after (head ff094d24) | 20 | 0 | 20 of 20 green in a row, all 5 cases each run |

Every app-shell test file that saves through the top bar (27 files, 155 tests, the ones using `pressStudioSave` or `useStudioSaveCoordinator`): green locally.

Local `tsc --noEmit` on app-shell reports no error in the changed file beyond the container's unbuilt `@object-ui/*` module resolution, which every file shares; the type-check lanes are CI's.
